attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will revitalize American diplomacy to ensure the United States remains the world's pivotal power and a principled force for peace and prosperity.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States should be at the head of the table whenever the safety and well-being of Americans is at stake, working in common cause with allies and partners.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has stormed out of meetings, leaving America's seat at the table vacant and American interests on the menu.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Americans deserve better leadership than the Trump Administration's approach to international meetings.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Diplomacy should be the United States' tool of first resort.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"American diplomacy is badly adrift and under resourced.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"American diplomats are demoralized.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
